detail: logical_device.json with a row missing id (or bad/duplicate id) loads only rows before it, log-only; the next profile Save rewrites the file without the later good rows. OSC skips the bad row and keeps the file. Needs a spec answer (skip+keep vs refuse save).
note: AD1 built: unreadable rows kept and written back; warning shown at start; any damage refuses save. e414d0b3, Spec: 06 (AD1)
title: Logical Device file: one bad row silently drops the good rows after it at the next Save (data loss)
